positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
-- Built RESTful APIs to streamline customer support by eliminating manual processes and reducing on-call troubleshooting time.
-- Implemented UI features enabling ops associates to independently access and update customer data in real time.
-- Planned and executed MySQL database table migration to optimize read/write speed and data modeling needs; heavily involved in schema design and code refactor spanning multiple services.
-- Pair-prototyped internal service and wrote initial tests to sync homeowner contact data across four services: internal tool, partner portal, Zendesk, and HubSpot.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
-- Compiled and processed global health data for use in ongoing analyses for over five disease research teams. 
-- Created efficient and replicable methods for extracting data, developing code, and organizing data sources.
-- Trained and mentored new hires.

company.name: Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation

positions.title: Curatorial Assistant
positions.description:
-- Curation of the Family La Bonche collection through object condition checking, managing of digital records, documentation, research, storage, panel writing, and display planning. 
-- Accessioned and deaccessioned museum objects using KE Emu collections management software to streamline collections inventory and reduce backlog.

positions.title: Iranian Heritage Project Researcher
positions.description:
-- Conducted in-depth interviews and research concerning Iranian immigrant communities within the North East of England. 
-- Research was produced as educational materials for local teachers, and integrated into the Destination Tyneside exhibit at Discovery Museum.

company.name: NORTHERN CULTURAL PROJECTS (NCP) COMMUNITY INTEREST COMPANY

positions.title: Sandyford Lives Exhibition Project Manager
positions.description:
-- Produced a community-oriented history exhibition incorporating stakeholder and community consultation feedback.  
-- Conducted archival and field research, oral history interviews, managed finances, event promotion (consultation meetings, flyer design and distribution, Facebook page, Twitter, and Blog), panel writing, display planning, exhibition installation, and event launch.
